home.tagline: Check the URL before it opens in your browser.
home.whatText: URLCheck registers itself as a link handler, so clicking an http/https link opens a small inspection popup instead of going straight to a browser. You get to see where the link really goes, strip the tracking junk, and only then hand it to the browser you want.
home.popupText: Every clicked link opens this before anything reaches the browser. The URL is split into domain, parameters and fragment; insecure links and known tracking parameters are flagged, and the button at the bottom picks which browser finally opens it.
home.popupAlt: The URLCheck popup for an insecure link

features.name: Intercept links
features.text: Installed as the default handler for http/https, so every clicked link passes through the popup. Stays in the tray.

features.name: Inspect before opening
features.text: A borderless popup shows the URL broken into scheme, host, parameters and fragment.

features.name: Clean the URL
features.text: Edit or remove any query parameter, clear the fragment, or strip tracking parameters in one click.

features.name: Script it
features.text: Lua scripts can rewrite every URL before it opens; install them from the scripts page.

features.name: Forward to another device
features.text: Send a URL to another URLCheck on the local network, end-to-end encrypted.

features.name: History
features.text: Every intercepted URL is recorded locally in SQLite and can be searched.

home.installBefore: Self-contained builds: the .NET runtime is bundled, so nothing else needs to be installed. Windows also needs the WebView2 runtime; Linux needs WebKitGTK and the AppIndicator library (see the
home.installAfter: ). Pick your system to open the latest release and download the matching file.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.subtitle: Click Install to hand the script to URLCheck. The app must be running and registered for {scheme}. If nothing happens, copy the script URL and add it under Scripts → Download in the app.
